changed.title: Exact nonlinear fan-in-two gate prices through four independent odd control planes at depth one with arbitrary even-weight pencils
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depths := fun (width : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate width 0)
let F := ZMod 2
∀ (q l : ℕ) (s : Fin l → ℕ),
  let V := Fin q → F
  let I := Σ i : Fin l, Fin (s i)
  let T := Matrix I I F
  let dot := fun (a z : V) => ∑ j, a j * z j
  ∀ (a b : Fin l → V), (∀ i, a i ≠ 0 ∧ b i ≠ 0 ∧ a i ≠ b i) →
    ∀ (U W : (i : Fin l) → Matrix (Fin (s i)) (Fin (s i)) F),
      (∀ i, (U i).rank = s i ∧ (W i).rank = s i ∧ (U i + W i).rank = s i) →
      ∀ S : Submodule F T, S = Submodule.span F {A : T | A ∈ S ∧ A.rank ≤ 2} →
        let line := fun i : Fin l => ({a i, b i, a i + b i} : Finset V)
        let lines := Finset.univ.image line
        let mass := fun H : Finset V => ∑ i, if line i = H then s i else 0
        let N := ∑ i, s i
        let free := Module.finrank F S
        let K := fun z : V =>
          Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun i => dot (a i) z • U i + dot (b i) z • W i)
        let w := Fintype.card (I ⊕ I)
        let coord := Fintype.equivFin (I ⊕ I)
        let table := fun (A : T) (z : V) (x y : Fin (w+1)) =>
          let X := Matrix.fromBlocks A (K z) (K z).transpose (0 : T)
          Fin.cases false (fun i => Fin.cases false (fun j =>
            decide (X (coord.symm i) (coord.symm j) ≠ 0)) y) x
        let bank := fun t : ℕ =>
          ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (tap : T → V → ℕ),
            PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack ((w+1)+(w+1)) C ∧
            (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧ C.gates.countP nonlinear ≤ t ∧
            ∀ A ∈ S, ∀ z : V,
              (depths ((w+1)+(w+1)) C).getD (tap A z) 0 ≤ 1 ∧
              PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (table A z) ⟨C.gates, tap A z⟩
        let odd := lines.filter (fun H => mass H % 2 = 1)
        let g := odd.card
        (∀ z : (H : ↥odd) → V, (∀ H, z H = 0 ∨ z H ∈ H.val) →
          (∑ H, z H) = 0 → ∀ H, z H = 0) →
        (∀ t : ℕ, bank t → free ≤ t ∧
          3*N + min g (if g % 2 = 0 then 4 else 3) ≤ 2*(t-free)) ∧
        ∀ t : ℕ, free + (3*N+g)/2 ≤ t → bank t

changed.title: Recognize signed score degree and return a smallest violating matching for optimal equality and unrestricted adjacent-width crown circuits
changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
∃ (M : Turing.TM2ComputableAux Bool Bool) (c : Nat), (∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)) ∧
∀ (k d : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let low := ∃ a : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Int, ∀ f : Fn, fits f →
    (score f : Int) = ((probe f).powerset.filter (fun T => T.card ≤ d)).sum a
  let ends := fun e : Fin k × Fin k => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin k))
  let realizes := fun (Q : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (value : Int) => d < Q.card ∧ (∀ e ∈ Q, e.1 < e.2) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ Q, ∀ z ∈ Q, e ≠ z → Disjoint (ends e) (ends z)) ∧
    ∃ cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn,
      (∀ T ⊆ Q, fits (cube T) ∧ probe (cube T) = T) ∧
      Q.powerset.sum (fun T => (-1 : Int)^(Q.card-T.card)*(score (cube T) : Int)) = value
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header d ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2])
  ∃ out : List Bool,
    Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
      (some (out.map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) (2^(c*(d+1))*(x.length+2)^c)) ∧
    (out = [true] ↔ low) ∧ (soft = [] → out = [true]) ∧
    (¬low → ∃ Q value, value ≠ 0 ∧ realizes Q value ∧ value.natAbs ≤ soft.length ∧
      Q.card ≤ d+1+soft.length.log2 ∧
      (∀ Z v, v ≠ 0 → realizes Z v → Q.card ≤ Z.card) ∧
      out = [false] ++ (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ Q)) ++ [decide (value < 0)] ++
        (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun i => value.natAbs.testBit i))
changed.unlocks: Tests the signed cancellation required for the Exact Matching reduction in polynomial time at degree one. In both circuit models a negative answer gives the smallest violating matching and its signed contrast.
changed.context: Use each circuit family’s involution description. Contradictory hard data give a vacuous degree bound. Otherwise remove pairs excluded by hard data and ignore forced soft rows in nonconstant coefficients. Scan sizes above d through the sharp trace bound. A sum of squared signed counts with positive squared endpoint determinants detects each size exactly. Skip the scan for zero soft rows. At the first positive size delete edges while that size still tests positive. Emit the remaining matching and its signed alternating score. Subset inversion gives the positive decision.

changed.title: A fan-in-two circuit counts matching keys and returns the least one from a tree of cyclic history equations
changed.statement:
∀ (k r q n w : Nat) (hk : 0 < k),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let W := Fin k → F
  let X := W × (Bool → Fin (r+1) → W)
  let G := Bool × Fin r × Fin k
  let I := Fin k ⊕ G
  let N := (2*r+3)*k
  let ix := fun s : Nat => (⟨s % k, Nat.mod_lt _ hk⟩ : Fin k)
  let rot := fun (s : Nat) (v : W) (j : Fin k) => v (ix (j.val+k-s % k))
  let start := fun (b : Bool) => if b then 3 else 1
  let feed := fun (b : Bool) (t : Nat) => if b then 3*(t+1)+1 else 2*t
  let mix := fun (b : Bool) (v : W) (j : Fin k) =>
    let d := if b then 2 else 1
    v j + v (ix (j.val+d)) + v (ix (j.val+k-d % k))
  let pair := fun (v z : X) => dotProduct v.1 z.1 +
    ∑ s : Fin (r+1), (dotProduct (v.2 false s) (z.2 false s) + dotProduct (v.2 true s) (z.2 true s))
  let form : I → Fin 3 → X → F := Sum.elim (fun j _ z => z.1 j) (fun g e z =>
    let b := g.1
    let t := g.2.1
    let j := g.2.2
    let y := mix b (z.2 b t.castSucc)
    if e.val = 0 then y (ix (j.val+1)) else if e.val = 1 then y (ix (j.val+2))
    else z.2 b t.succ j + y j + rot (feed b t.val) z.1 j)
  let inputs := (2+2*r)*k+q*(N+1)+n*((2*r+1)*k)
  ∃ (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (ok : Fin (inputs+C.size))
    (countWire : Fin (k+1) → Fin (inputs+C.size)) (keyWire : Fin k → Fin (inputs+C.size)),
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack inputs C ∧
    C.output = ok.val ∧ C.size ≤ 2^(90+(3*min N w)/2)*(k+r+q+n+5)^40 ∧
    ∀ (name : Bool → W) (c : Bool → Fin r → W) (obs : Fin q → X) (rhs : Fin q → F)
      (bag : Fin n → I → Bool),
      let pack := fun v : W => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => decide (v j ≠ 0))
      let lanes := fun (side : Bool) (tape : X) => (List.finRange (r+1)).flatMap (fun j => pack (tape.2 side j))
      let leafBits := fun (p : I → Bool) => List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => p (.inl j)) ++
        [false,true].flatMap (fun b => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun t =>
          List.ofFn (fun j : Fin k => p (.inr (b,t,j)))))
      let bits := pack (name false) ++ pack (name true) ++
        [false,true].flatMap (fun b => (List.finRange r).flatMap (fun t => pack (c b t))) ++
        (List.finRange q).flatMap (fun i => pack (obs i).1 ++ lanes false (obs i) ++ lanes true (obs i) ++
          [decide (rhs i ≠ 0)]) ++ (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun v => leafBits (bag v))
      let wire := fun i : Fin (inputs+C.size) => (C.wires bits).getD i.val false
      let D := {z : X // (∀ b, z.2 b 0 = rot (start b) z.1) ∧ ∀ i, pair (obs i) z = 0}
      let span := fun (p : I → Bool) => Submodule.span F
        {f : D → F | ∃ (j : I) (e : Fin 3), p j = true ∧ f = fun z : D => form j e z.val}
      let layout := (∃ root : Fin n, ∀ j, bag root j = true) ∧
        ∀ v : Fin n, (∃ one : I, ∀ j, bag v j = decide (j = one)) ∨
          ∃ l h : Fin n, l < v ∧ h < v ∧ (∀ j, bag l j = true → bag h j = false) ∧
            ∀ j, bag v j = (bag l j || bag h j)
      let fits := layout ∧ ∀ v : Fin n,
        Module.finrank F ((span (bag v) ⊓ span (fun j => !(bag v j))) : Submodule F (D → F)) ≤ w
      let actual := fun (key : W) (b : Bool) (time : Fin (r+1)) =>
        ((List.finRange r).take time.val).foldl (fun prev tick =>
          let y := mix b prev
          fun j : Fin k => y j + (1+y (ix (j.val+1)))*y (ix (j.val+2)) +
            rot (feed b tick.val) key j + c b tick j) (rot (start b) key + name b)
      let hit := fun key : W => ∀ i, pair (obs i) (key,actual key) = rhs i
      let cnt := Nat.card {key : W // hit key}
      let out := fun j => (if wire (keyWire j) then 1 else 0 : F)
      let code : W → Nat := fun v => ∑ j : Fin k, if v j = 0 then 0 else 2^j.val
      (wire ok = true ↔ fits) ∧ (∀ s, wire (countWire s) = (if wire ok then cnt else 0).testBit s.val) ∧
        (wire ok = true → 0 < cnt → hit out ∧ ∀ key, hit key → code out ≤ code key) ∧
        ((wire ok = false ∨ cnt = 0) → out = 0)

changed.title: A supplied adaptive pair probe tree admits polynomial certification and optimal circuit fits at each transposition size
changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]
let pairs := fun n : Nat => (List.finRange n).flatMap (fun i =>
  ((List.finRange n).filter (fun j => decide (i < j))).map (fun j => (i,j)))
let fast := fun g : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) g,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)
∃ solve : List Bool → List Bool, fast solve ∧
∀ (k : Nat) (crown : Bool), 2 ≤ k → (crown = true → 7 ≤ k) →
  let nr := if crown then k+2 else k
  let nc := if crown then k+1 else k
  let A := fun (i : Fin nr) (j : Fin nc) => if crown then
    decide (i.val ≠ k+1 ∧ ¬ (i.val < k ∧ i.val = j.val)) else decide (i.val = j.val)
  let Fn := (Fin nr → Bool) → (Fin nc → Bool) → Bool
  let eligible := fun f : Fn => ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    (if crown then PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 2*k+1 else PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*k) ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C ∧ ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)
  ∀ (hard : List ((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)))
    (soft : List (((Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool)) × Bool)),
  let fits := fun f : Fn => eligible f ∧ ∀ h ∈ hard, f h.1 h.2 = crown
  let score := fun f : Fn => (soft.filter (fun t => decide (f t.1.1 t.1.2 = t.2))).length
  let probe := fun f : Fn => (pairs k).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    f (fun i => decide (i.val = e.1.val ∨ i.val = e.2.val)) (fun _ => false) = !crown)
  let vs := (pairs k).toFinset
  ∀ tree : List (List Bool × (Fin k × Fin k)),
  let keys := tree.map Prod.fst
  keys.Nodup → (∀ a e, (a,e) ∈ tree → e ∈ vs) →
  (∀ a bit, a ++ [bit] ∈ keys → a ∈ keys) →
  let atNode := fun (a : List Bool) => (tree.find? (fun r => decide (r.1 = a))).map Prod.snd
  let route := fun f : Fn => (List.range tree.length).foldl (fun a _ =>
    (atNode a).elim a (fun e => a ++ [decide (e ∈ probe f)])) ([] : List Bool)
  let good := ∀ a : List Bool, ∃ (b : Int) (w : Fin k × Fin k → Int), ∀ f : Fn,
    fits f → route f = a → (score f : Int) = b + (probe f).sum w
  let mask := fun S : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ S))
  let banks := fun z : (Fin nr → Bool) × (Fin nc → Bool) => List.ofFn z.1 ++ List.ofFn z.2
  let x := [crown] ++ header k ++ header hard.length ++ hard.flatMap banks ++
    header soft.length ++ soft.flatMap (fun t => banks t.1 ++ [t.2]) ++ header tree.length ++
    tree.flatMap (fun t => header t.1.length ++ t.1 ++ header t.2.1.val ++ header t.2.2.val)
  let bits := fun z : Nat => (List.range (soft.length.log2+1)).map (fun j => z.testBit j)
  (good → ∃ slot : Fin (k/2+1) → List Bool,
    solve x = [true] ++ (List.finRange (k/2+1)).flatMap slot ∧
    ∀ s, let present := ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val
         (¬present → slot s = List.replicate (1+(pairs k).length+soft.length.log2+1) false) ∧
         (present → ∃ f : Fn, fits f ∧ (probe f).card = s.val ∧
           (∀ g : Fn, fits g → (probe g).card = s.val → score g ≤ score f) ∧
           slot s = [true] ++ mask (probe f) ++ bits (score f))) ∧
  (¬good → ∃ (a : List Bool) (P T : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (cube : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) → Fn),
    P = ((tree.filter (fun t => (t.1 ++ [true]).isPrefixOf a)).map Prod.snd).toFinset ∧
    Disjoint P T ∧ 2 ≤ T.card ∧
    (∀ U ⊆ T, fits (cube U) ∧ route (cube U) = a ∧ probe (cube U) = P ∪ U) ∧
    T.powerset.sum (fun U => (-1 : Int)^(T.card-U.card)*(score (cube U) : Int)) ≠ 0 ∧
    solve x = [false] ++ header a.length ++ a ++ mask P ++ mask T)

let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]

let pairs := fun k : Nat => (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i =>

  Function.Involutive P ∧ ∀ i, P i ≠ i ∧ G (min i (P i)) (max i (P i)) = true
∃ write decode reverseQ : List Bool → List Bool, fast write ∧ fast decode ∧ fast reverseQ ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (hard : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)))
    (soft : List ((Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool)),
  let m := soft.length
  let ends := fun e : Fin n × Fin n => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin n))
  let E := (pairs n).toFinset.filter (fun e =>
    ∀ z ∈ hard, ¬(ends e ⊆ z.1) ∧ ¬(ends e ⊆ z.2))
  let lists := fun (S : Finset (Fin n × Fin n)) (t : (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n)) × Bool) =>
    Disjoint t.1.1 t.1.2 ∧ ∀ e ∈ S, ends e ⊆ t.1.1 ∨ ends e ⊆ t.1.2
  (∀ S ⊆ E, 2 ≤ S.card →
    (∀ e ∈ S, ∀ f ∈ S, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)) →
    (soft.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length =
      (soft.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (lists S t))).length) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R T : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ T))
  let valid := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    ∀ z ∈ hard, obs f z.1 z.2 = false

  let size := fun f : Fn => ((code f).filter id).length

    let out := fun P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => decode (input ++
      (List.finRange k).flatMap (fun i => bits (k.log2+1) (P i).val))
    let red := fun P : Equiv.Perm (Fin k) => ((pairs k).filter
      (fun e => decide (P e.1 = e.2) && R e.1 e.2)).length

    let oldEdges := ((pairs v).filter (fun e => G e.1 e.2)).map (fun e => (e.1.val,e.2.val))

    let probes := (pairs n).filter (fun e => decide ((e.1.val,e.2.val) ∈ reds))
    let row := fun (e : Fin n × Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map
      (fun i => decide (i = e.1 ∨ i = e.2))
    let zero := List.replicate n false
    reverseQ (paint v G R) = header n ++ header bans.length ++
      bans.flatMap (fun e => row e ++ zero) ++ header probes.length ++
      probes.flatMap (fun e => row e ++ zero ++ [true]) ∧
    let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool

      f (fun i => decide (i = e.1 ∨ i = e.2)) (fun _ => false)
    let ok := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
      PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
      PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
      ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ bans, hit f e = false) ∧ ((pairs n).filter (hit f)).length = h+1
    ∀ j : Nat, Nat.card {P : Equiv.Perm (Fin v) // perfect v G P ∧
      ((pairs v).filter (fun e => decide (P e.1 = e.2) && R e.1 e.2)).length = j} =
      Nat.card {f : Fn // ok f ∧ (probes.filter (hit f)).length = j}

changed.title: Randomized relative approximation of the total number of fitting optimal fan-in-two AND/OR equality functions, with zero on every infeasible input
changed.statement:
let header := fun j : Nat => List.replicate j true ++ [false]
let fast := fun f : List Bool → List Bool =>
  ∃ M : Turing.TM2ComputableInPolyTime (fun x : List Bool => x) (fun x : List Bool => x) f,
    ∀ i, Finite (M.tm.Γ i)

let value := fun bs : List Bool => bs.foldr (fun b z => 2*z+b.toNat) 0
∃ (estimate : List Bool → List Bool) (randDegree : Nat), fast estimate ∧

∀ (n : Nat), 2 ≤ n →
  ∀ (pos : List (Finset (Fin n))) (neg : List (Finset (Fin n) × Finset (Fin n))),
  (∀ R ∈ pos, R.card ≤ 3) →
  (∀ i : Fin n, (pos.toFinset.filter (fun R => R.card = 3 ∧ i ∈ R)).card ≤ 2) →
  let Fn := (Fin n → Bool) → (Fin n → Bool) → Bool
  let obs := fun (f : Fn) (R S : Finset (Fin n)) =>
    f (fun i => decide (i ∈ R)) (fun j => decide (j ∈ S))
  let fits := fun f : Fn => (∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C ∧ C.size+1 ≤ 2*n ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun i j : Fin n => decide (i=j)) C ∧
    ∀ x y, f x y = C.eval (List.ofFn x ++ List.ofFn y)) ∧
    (∀ R ∈ pos, obs f R ∅ = true) ∧ (∀ z ∈ neg, obs f z.1 z.2 = false)

  let bank := fun R : Finset (Fin n) => (List.finRange n).map (fun i => decide (i ∈ R))
  let input := header n ++ header pos.length ++ pos.flatMap bank ++
    header neg.length ++ neg.flatMap (fun z => bank z.1 ++ bank z.2)

  let total := Nat.card {f : Fn // fits f}
  ∀ (b a : Nat), 2 ≤ b → 1 ≤ a →
    let prefixBits := header b ++ header a ++ input
    let ell := (prefixBits.length+2)^randDegree
    let z := fun tape : Fin ell → Bool => value (estimate (prefixBits ++ List.ofFn tape))
    (total = 0 → ∀ tape, z tape = 0) ∧
    2^a * Nat.card {tape : Fin ell → Bool //
      (4*b-4)*total ≤ z tape ∧ z tape ≤ (4*b+4)*total} ≥ (2^a-1)*2^ell

changed.statement:
let header := fun z : Nat => List.replicate z true ++ [false]

∀ (k w : Nat) (E P H : Finset (Fin k × Fin k)) (rows : List (Finset (Fin k × Fin k) × Bool)),
  (∀ e ∈ E, e.1 < e.2) → (∀ e ∈ P, e.1 < e.2) → (∀ e ∈ H, e.1 < e.2) →
  let ends := fun e : Fin k × Fin k => ({e.1,e.2} : Finset (Fin k))
  let valid := fun Q : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => Q ⊆ E ∧
    ∀ e ∈ Q, ∀ f ∈ Q, e ≠ f → Disjoint (ends e) (ends f)
  let signed := fun Q : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) =>
    ((rows.filter (fun t => t.2 && decide (Q ⊆ t.1))).length : Int) -
      ((rows.filter (fun t => !t.2 && decide (Q ⊆ t.1))).length : Int)
  let together := fun e f => ∃ Q, valid Q ∧ e ∈ Q ∧ f ∈ Q ∧ signed Q ≠ 0
  let tag := fun e : Fin k × Fin k => k+e.1.val*k+e.2.val

  let layout := List.range k ++ (pairs k).map tag

      (B : Fin (t+1) → Finset Nat) =>
    par 0 = 0 ∧ (∀ i, i ≠ 0 → par i < i) ∧
    (∀ i, B i ⊆ vertices ∧ (B i).card ≤ width+1) ∧
    (∀ v ∈ vertices, ∃ a, v ∈ B a ∧ ∀ i, v ∈ B i → i ≠ a → i ≠ 0 ∧ v ∈ B (par i)) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ E, (∃ i, tag e ∈ B i ∧ e.1.val ∈ B i) ∧ (∃ i, tag e ∈ B i ∧ e.2.val ∈ B i)) ∧
    ∀ e ∈ E, ∀ f ∈ E, e ≠ f → together e f → ∃ i, tag e ∈ B i ∧ tag f ∈ B i
  let treeword := fun (t : Nat) (par : Fin (t+1) → Fin (t+1)) (B : Fin (t+1) → Finset Nat) =>
    header (t+1) ++ (List.finRange (t+1)).flatMap (fun i =>
      bits ((t+1).log2+1) (par i).val ++ layout.map (fun v => decide (v ∈ B i)))
  ∀ (t : Nat) (par : Fin (t+1) → Fin (t+1)) (B : Fin (t+1) → Finset Nat), decomp w t par B →
  let mask := fun A : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (pairs k).map (fun e => decide (e ∈ A))
  let x := header k ++ header w ++ mask E ++ mask P ++ mask H ++ header rows.length ++
    rows.flatMap (fun r => r.2 :: mask r.1) ++ treeword t par B
  let score := fun Q : Finset (Fin k × Fin k) => (rows.filter
    (fun r => decide (decide ((Q ∩ r.1).Nonempty) = r.2))).length
  let count := fun s j : Nat => (E.powerset.filter (fun Q =>
    valid Q ∧ P ⊆ Q ∧ Disjoint Q H ∧ Q.card = s ∧ score Q = j)).card
  let out := (List.range (k/2+1)).flatMap (fun s => (List.range (rows.length+1)).flatMap
    (fun j => bits ((pairs k).length+1) (count s j)))
  Nonempty (Turing.TM2OutputsInTime M.tm (x.map M.inputAlphabet.invFun)
    (some (out.map M.outputAlphabet.invFun)) (2^(c*(w+1))*(x.length+2)^c))
